name: 922 Pallet Labeler
description: Applies each order's PALLET 1/2/3 label to its existing Teams card - the second pass for when the cards were made before the Pallet Organizer was filled in.
author: Anthony Sieben

setup: The batch's Teams cards must already exist (922 Setup -> Generate Teams Cards).
The batch's 'PO H{batch} Pallet & Rod Organizer.xlsx' must have the orders filled in under PALLET 1 / PALLET 2 / PALLET 3 on the Pallet Organizer sheet.
Pick the 'Batch NNN' folder when it asks.
how_it_works: Reads the Pallet Organizer sheet and works out which pallet each order belongs to.
Matches each order to its existing card in the D922 PIPELINE board by card title.
Adds the pallet label to that card. Any other labels the card already has - REPEAT, materials - are left alone.
Re-running is safe: a card that already has the right label just keeps it.
It never creates cards. If the Pallet Organizer is empty or unreadable it stops and tells you, instead of doing half a job.
output: Every order's card on the D922 PIPELINE board carries its PALLET 1/2/3 label.
The console lists each card and the label it got, plus any order that is not on the Pallet Organizer sheet.

fields.label: 922 Production Packages Root
fields.description: Where 'Batch {N}' folders live. Leave blank to auto-detect '922 QTDR Production Packages' under your OneDrive Pilot Program folder.
fields.placeholder: Auto-detect: OneDrive \ ... \ Pilot Program \ 922 QTDR Production Packages

fields.label: Pallet Labeler Webhook URL (override)
fields.description: Leave blank to use TechDeck's built-in pallet-labeling flow. Only set this to point at a different Power Automate flow (get the URL from that flow's trigger). Use the Dry run toggle below to preview without posting.

fields.label: Dry run (preview only)
fields.description: When on, work out every card's label and log it, but do not post to the webhook. A preview JSON is saved so you can check it.

fields.label: Sentry Drone mode
fields.description: Pick the file or folder through the targeting-drone kill-cam - crosshair cursor, lock-on, and a railgun strike on the target. Off = a normal Explorer dialog. Buy the Sentry Drone at Woogy's Emporium; set every app at once from My Stuff.
